topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I've been watching the sky, these days, trying to read the patterns. The clouds gather differently now, like they're whispering secrets to each other. Over at Mr. Thompson's, there's a new kind of rumble, not just the usual creaks and groans. He's talking about putting up a fence—wood and nails, he says, to keep the world at bay. It's not something we've ever needed before. I keep thinking maybe if I rearrange the chairs in my living room just so, it might change things, might make the idea of fences irrelevant. But the chairs never seem to land in quite the right spot. The whispers grow louder, and I find myself watching the line between his yard and mine, wondering what happens when we start drawing lines in places where only air used to be.
